The short facts for disposal of the revisional application is that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Other Class Suit No. 8 of 1997 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Madhupur for decree of permanent injunction against the defendant opposite parties restraining from disturbing their peaceful possession stating inter alia, that. the land of C.S. Plot no.4 1 1 under C.S. Khatian No. 155 corresponding to S.A. No. 276 of mouja Madhupur belonged to Roy Mohan Tepal who was succeeded by his son Kokaram Tapal. Kokaram Tepal sold entire plot No. 411 measuring 1.01 acres of land while exercising title and possession Manindra, Amarendra and Upendra Chandra Bhowmik by registered sale deed dated 25.2.1943. 

 13. He next submits that the exhibited documents of the plaintiffs in respect of their title and possession clearly proved their title and possession over the suit land on the basis of the S.A. Khatian and subsequent Khatians. The rent receipts and other Taxes in the name of the plaintiffs also proved the title and possession of the plaintiffs in the suit property.
